content.short: Revuto is a subscription management platform on Cardano that uses virtual debit cards and crypto payments.
content.description: Revuto is a pioneering platform on Cardano designed to give users complete control over their digital subscriptions. By utilizing virtual Visa debit cards and integrated crypto payment options, the app allows individuals to approve, block, or postpone subscription charges with ease. Revuto addresses the common challenge of 'subscription fatigue' by providing a centralized dashboard for financial management, helping users save money and avoid unwanted renewals. Powered by the REVU token, the ecosystem creates a practical bridge between traditional fiat services and decentralized finance.
